description: This file defines an interface, HashInterface, for incremental hash implementations within the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares methods for updating, completing, and resetting hashing operations.

classes.name: HashInterface
classes.description: An interface for implementing various incremental hashing algorithms.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hashing process and returns the digest.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the hash to its initial state.
